noCodes: UTC's registrar Class Schedule Information pages (utc.edu/academic-affairs/registrar/registration-information/class-schedule) publish no building-code list; room codes live in the login-only CPI scheduling tool (cpi.utc.edu), and no facilities building list with codes is public.
